prior.evidence: Demonstration boundary makes accounting a required evidence source. The scenario set adds a processor refund missing from supplied accounting entries, and success criterion 8 requires all three sources plus an accounting-side discrepancy and distinguishes missing export evidence from a proven missing book entry.

The core journey adds Freeze reviewed workpaper. Proposed approval boundary explicitly separates saving a disposition from freezing, fixes the immutable source/run/rule/review snapshot, retains unresolved labels, requires a new reviewable version and freeze after changes, and rejects stale freeze requests. Report states and success criterion 9 repeat this behavior.
